name: vvater-film
description: The VVater film. Script and sources in docs/21-film.md.

scripts.render: node check.mjs && remotion render Film out/vvater-film-raw.mp4 && npm run copies
scripts.copies: ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/vvater-film-raw.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -c:a aac -b:a 192k out/vvater-film.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/vvater-film-raw.mp4 -c:v copy -an out/vvater-film-no-voice.mp4
